Rule.name: FSGov-Remediation-Evidence
Rule.Description: Closes the revocation loop. On entry to the Remediation or End phase it records, for every item a reviewer revoked, an audit event naming the reviewer, the entitlement, the decision time and the provisioning request the revoke produced. Verification that the access is actually gone is done by the next aggregation and the fsgov evidence diff; this rule only records what was decided and sent.
